annotations.title: Price a modern classic pergola kit

description: Price a modern classic Baldwin fiberglass pergola kit (four columns with an aluminum-look finish and hat trim): pre-engineered and custom crafted, with all hardware, instructions, and a high-end factory paint finish. The structure stays the same while the trim adjusts in three architecture steps: classic (Greco-Roman), modern classic, and modern. Returns the same price shown on the live 3D configurator. Budgetary estimate, not a binding quote. Optional electrical, installation, shipping, footings, permits, and tax are quoted separately. Call get_pergola_guidance first. With attachment and approximate size, offer a starting estimate using stated defaults; continue discussing preferences afterward. Explain support-center versus overall roof dimensions. Present the exact returned configurator_url as a clickable text hyperlink to Baldwin website, or a button if supported. Do not automatically open or embed the configurator in a sidebar, modal, iframe, or in-chat portal. Introduce the available user controls.

ai_client.description: AI application when known, e.g. ChatGPT or Claude. Client-reported; do not guess.

ai_model.description: Exact model only if actually known; otherwise omit. Do not infer it from the application.

architecture.description: Architectural style, set by trim only; the structure stays the same. classic is Greco-Roman, modern_classic is the middle step, modern is the most contemporary.

color.description: Paint color. "custom" is not currently priceable online for modern classic.

column_style.description: Column size and shape. 10recessed and 12recessed add $400 for each of the four columns and are a special order based on site conditions.

conversation_summary.description: Factual project summary under 1,500 characters: stated goals, use, architecture, accessories, alternatives and open design questions. Distinguish requests from ideas discussed. Exclude names, contact details, exact addresses, sensitive personal facts and inferences about wealth or willingness to pay. Saved for later contact submission; not yet delivered to sales. Follow host disclosure rules.

dentils.description: Include dentil molding. Adds $5 per dentil to the price.

fanlight_percent.description: Fan-light preview level. The saved modern classic link names this fanLight.

project_country.description: Country of the project when stated or unambiguously established. No IP-based guesses.

project_id.description: The project_id returned by an earlier call in this conversation. Reuse it so the summary stays with the same project.

project_region.description: Stated state/province/region, e.g. Nebraska. No street address or precise location.

project_type.description: residential, commercial, institutional, or unknown. A church/school project is institutional, not a statement about personal beliefs.

project_use.description: Generic stated purpose, e.g. church gathering area or family patio. No individual or organization names.

purlin_spacing_in.description: Desired purlin spacing in inches on-center.

rafter_spacing_in.description: Desired rafter spacing in inches on-center.

sconce_percent.description: Sconce preview level, 0 to 100. Keep this on a saved design link.

shade.description: 1 includes the retractable shade in the saved design. 0 leaves it off.

shade_color.description: Retractable shade fabric name, for example Sunbrella Oyster 4642.

shade_position.description: Whether the saved shade is extended or retracted.
